title: Peloton Yoga Class Weekly Class Length Trend
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=peloton:yoga class_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(class_minutes) as avg_duration, max(class_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst class length for Peloton yoga class events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture class_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average class length with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether Peloton yoga class tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
